senses.gloss:
mn. (-रः-रं)
1 Poison.
2 An antidote.
m. (-रः)
Sickness, disease.
n. (-रं)
1 Sprinkling, wetting.
2 The fifth of the eleven Karaṇas.
f. (-रा)
Swallowing.
(-री)
A species of grass, (Andropogon serratus); also गरागरी.
E.
गर to hurt, and अच् affix, or गृ to wet or sprinkle, or again गॄ to swallow, affix अप्.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं)
1 Antidote, an antidote.
2 Sanative, healthy.
m. (-घ्नः)
A species of Basil.
f. (-घ्नी)
A fish (the young of the Ophiocephalus lata, HAM.)
E.
गर, and घ्न what destroys.

n. (-णं)
1 Wetting, sprinkling.
2 Swallowing.
E.
गृ to wet, or गृ to swallow, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 A poisoner, poisoning.
2 Unwholesome, occasioning sickness.
n. (-दं)
Poison.
E.
गर poison, and द who gives.

m. (-तः)
A peacock.
E.
गर sprinkling, (of rain,) and ब्रत religious observance.

m. (-भः)
The foetus or embryo: see गर्भ.
E.
गृ to drop, &c. अभच् aff.

n. (-लं)
1 The venom of a snake or venom in general.
2 A bundle of grass, or hay.
3 Measure in general.
E.
गर poison, &c. and ल what gets or possesses.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Venomous, poisonous.
E.
गरल, and इनि aff.

f. (-री)
A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus): see खरा and गरी; also अगरी.

n. (-कं)
The seed of the Śobhāñjana or Morunga.
E.
गर poison, and आत्मक nature.

f. (-का)
Lac, the animal red dye so called.

m. (-मा)
1 Weight, heaviness.
2 Venerableness.
E.
गुरु and इमनिच् aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 Heaviest, excessively heavy.
2 Very venerable.
E.
गुरु heavy, इष्ठच् superlative affix, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Heaviest, very heavy.
2 Highly venerable.
3 Worst.
E.
see the last, affix ईयसुन्.

m. (डः)
The bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU; he is generally represented as a being something between a man and a bird, and considered as sovereign of the feathered race; he is the son of KAŚYAPA and VINATĀ, and younger brother of ARUṆA.
E.
गरुत् a wing, डी to fly, affix ड, and the त of the noun dropped, who flies like a bird, or गृ to moisten, and उडच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-डः)
1 Gold.
2 A Mantra or charm against poison.
3 An emerald.
E.
गरुड the vehicle of VIṢṆU, and अण् affix; of or relating to GARUḌA.

m. (-जः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
गरुड, and ध्वज a symbol; whose symbol is GARUḌA.

n. (-तं)
A species of metre having four lines to the stanza, and sixteen syllables to each line.

m. (-जः)
ARUṆA, the charioteer of the sun.
E.
गरुड, and अग्रज elder born; the elder brother of GARUḌA.

n. (-तं)
An emerald.
E.
गरुड GARUḌA, and अङ्किय marked.

m. (-श्मा)
An emerald.
E.
गरुड, and अश्मान् a stone: see the preceding.

n. (-णं)
The emerald.
E.
गरुत, and उत्तीर्ण passed over.

m. (-रुत्)
A wing.
E.
गृ to moisten, and उति Uṇādi aff.

m. (-त्मान्)
1 The bird of VIṢṆU.
2 A bird in general.
E.
गरुत् a wing, and मतुप् poss. aff.

n. (-त्)
The emerald.
E.
गरुत्मत् GARUḌA, and अण् affix; derived from or relating to GARUḌA; the gem is supposed to be generated from his voided phlegm.

m. (-धी)
A quail.
E.
गरुत् a wing, and योधिन् who fights.

m. (-र्ग)
One of the ten principal Munis or saints, a son of BRAHMĀ.
f. (गर्गी)
Wife of GARGA.
E.
गृ to sprinkle, ग Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-र्ग्गः-र्ग्गी-र्ग्गं)
Descended from the age GARGA.
E.
गर्ग्ग, and अण् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A kind of fish, (Pimelodus gagora, HAM)
f. (-री)
1 A churn.
2 A water vessel, a guglet.
E.
गर्ग an imitative sound, a guggling, and र what makes.

m. (-टः)
A kind of fish, (Pimelodus gagora, HAM.)

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
A descendant of GARGA.
E.
गर्ग, and छ aff.

r. 1st cl. (गर्घति)
To go or move.

r. 10th cl. (गर्जयति)
To sound.
r. 1st cl. (गर्जति)
To emit a deep or full sound, to sound as distant thunder, to roar as a lion, &c.

n. (-र्जं)
1 The roaring of elephants.
2 The grumbling of clouds, &c.
E.
गर्ज to roar or growl, affix अच्.

m. (-कः)
A fish, commonly Gajar.
E.
गर्ज to grumble, affix वुन्.

n. (-नं)
1 Sound, noise.
2 Passion, wrath.
3 Excessive indignation.
4 Reproach, menace.
5 War, battle, conflict.
6 The grumbling of clouds, &c.
E.
गर्ज to grumble or roar, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be sounded or roared.
E.
गर्ज to sound, अनीयर् aff.

n. (-रं)
A carrot.

m. (-र्जिः)
The muttering of clouds or distant thunder.
E.
गर्ज to sound as thunder, कि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sounded, roared, bellowed.
m. (-तः)
An elephant in rut.
n. (-तं)
The muttering of clouds or rolling of distant thunder.
E.
गर्ज to roar, &c. affix क्त.

mfn. (-र्ज्यः-र्ज्या-र्ज्यं)
To be roared or sounded.
E.
गर्ज to sound, ण्यत् aff.

m. (-र्त्तः)
1 A hole in general.
2 The hollow of the loins.
3 The name of a country; also त्रिगर्त्त, in the north-west of India.
4 A kind of disease.
E.
गृ to drop, Uṇādi affix तन्.

f. (-का)
A weaver's workshop.
E.
गर्त्त a hole, affix ठन्, the weaver sits at his loom with his feet in a hollow or hole below. the level of the floor.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (गर्दति गर्दंयति)
To sound, to roar.

m. (-भः)
1 Smell, odour.
2 An ass.
f. (-भी)
1 A she-ass.
2 An insect, a kind of beetle springing from cow dung.
3 A disease of the skin, eruption of round, red, and painful spots; also गर्दभिका.
4 A creeper, (Clitoria ternata.)
n. (-भं)
The white lotus.
E.
गर्द to sound, Uṇādi affix अभच्.

n. (-नं)
The skin or hide of an ass.
E.
गर्द्दभ, and अजिन a skin.

mf. (-कः-का)
A plant, (Ovieda verticellata.)
E.
गर्द्दभ an ass, and शाक a vegetable.

m. (-ण्डः)
A kind of tree, commonly Pārspīpal, (Hibiscus populneoides)
E.
गर्द्दभ smell, अम to go, and ड aff.

m. (-यः)
The white lotus.
E.
गर्द्दभ smell, and आह्वय an appellation.

f. (-का)
A cutaneous disease, a blotch, an eruption.
E.
कन् fem. form added to गर्द्धभ.

m. (-र्द्धः)
1 Eagerness, greediness.
2 The Pārspīpal: see गर्द्धभाण्ड.
E.
गृध to desire, to be greedy, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धी-र्द्धं)
1 Derived from a vulture.
2 Greedy.
m. (-द्धः)
1 Desire, greediness, cupidity.
2 An arrow.
E.
गृध greedy, affix अण् or गृध्र with अण् affix, and र rejected optionally.

mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धी-र्द्धं)
Derived from a vulture.
E.
गृध्र, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Covetous, greedy.
E.
गृध to be greedy, affix युच्.

mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिनी-र्द्धि)
Greedy, covetous.
E.
गर्द्ध, and इनि aff.

r. 10th cl. (गर्धयति)
To desire or covet: see गृध.

r. 1st cl. (गर्ब्बति)
To move, to go or approach.

m. (-र्ब्बः)
Pride, haughtiness.
E.
गर्ब्ब to be proud, अच् affix; also read गर्व्व.

m. (-र्ब्भः)
A foetus, &c.: see the next.
f. (-र्ब्भा)
Interval of time, division of time or place.

m. (-र्भः)
1 A foetus or embryo.
2 A child.
3 The belly.
4 The inside, the middle.
5 Joining, union.
6 The rough coat of the fruit of the Jaka.
7 An inner apartment, a lying-in chamber.
8 Any interior chamber, the adytum of a temple, &c.
9 The bed of the Ganges, when the river is fullest; that is, on the fourteenth day of the dark half of the month Bhādra, or in the height of the rains; as high as the river flows at this period, so far extends the Garbha, after which the Tīra or proper bank begins, and extends for 150 cubits; this space is holy ground.
10 The calyx of the lotus. The interior or inner part of any thing.
E.
गृ to drop, or गॄ to swallow, Uṇādi affix भन्; also read गर्ब्भ.

mfn. (-र्भः-र्भी-र्भं)
1 Uterine, fœtal.
2 Relating to conception, (any act or ceremony, &c.)
E.
गर्भ, and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A chaplet of flowers, &c. worn in the hair.
n. (-कं)
A period of a day and two nights.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Impregnating, fecundatory, procreative, producing impregnation.
m. (-रः)
A plant, (Nagelia putranjiva.)
E.
गर्भ, and कर what makes.

m. (-शः)
The uterus.
E.
गर्भ, and कोश sheathe.

n. (-हं)
1 An inner chamber.
2 A lying-in chamber.
3 The sanctuary or adytum of a temple.
E.
गर्भ, and गृह a house.

n. (-णं)
Conception, impregnation.
E.
गर्भ, and ग्रहण taking.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
Producing abortion.
E.
गर्भ, and घातिन् what destroys.

n. (-नं)
Quickening, motion of the foetus in utero.
E.
गर्भ, and चलन moving.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bearing a child.
2 Miscarrying.
E.
गर्भ and च्युत falling.

f. (-तिः)
1 Birth, delivery.
2 Miscarriage.
E.
गर्म, and च्युति falling.

m. (-ण्डः)
Enlargement of the navel.
E.
गर्भ the belly, and अण्ड an egg, the penultimate made short.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Impregnating, procreative.
m. (-दः)
A tree, (Nagelia putranjiva.)
f. (-दा)
A shrub so called.
E.
गर्भ a foetus, and द what gives, with reference to the supposed virtue of the plant; also गर्भदातृ (-ता-त्री-तृ).

mfn. (-द्रुक् or द्रुट्)
Causing abortion.
E.
गर्भ, and द्रुह what injures.

n. (-णं)
Impregnation, gestation.
E.
गर्भ, and धारण holding.

f. (-डी)
The umbilical cord.
E.
गर्भ, and नाडी a vessel.

m. (-वः)
Secundines.
E.
गर्भ, and परिस्रव what exudes.

m. (-की)
Rice ripening after two months.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Producing abortion.
m. (-कः)
A red kind of morunga.
E.
गर्भ the foetus, पत to fall, in the causal form, and वुञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Producing abortion.
f. (-नी)
Any plant or drug supposed to have that effect.
E.
गर्भ, and पातन causing to fall.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
Producing abortion.
f. (-नी)
A kind of potherb: see विशल्या.
E.
as in the last, affixes णिनि and ङीप्.

n. (-णं)
Gestation.
E.
गर्भ, and पोषण nourishing.

mfn. (-पः-पी-पं)
A child, an infant.
E.
गर्भ an embryo, and रूप form; also गर्भरूपकः.

f. (-ती)
A pregnant female.
E.
गर्भ a foetus, and मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A kind of vectis or instrument for extracting the dead foetus.
E.
गर्भ, and शङ्क, a probe.

f. (-य्या)
The uterus.
E.
गर्भ, and शय्या a bed.

m. (-घः)
The womb, the uterus.
E.
गर्भ the embryo, and आशय asylum or abode.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Situated in the womb.
2 Centrical, internal, within the centre of any thing.
E.
गर्भ, and स्थ what abides.

m. (-वः)
Abortion, miscarriage.
E.
गर्भ the embryo, and स्राव expulsion.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Producing or occasioning abortion.
E.
गर्भ, and स्राविन् what causes to issue.

n. (-रं)
1 An inner and private room, the female apartments, the lying-in chamber.
2 The sanctuary of a temple, the chamber where the object of worship is placed.
E.
गर्भ the foetus, and आगार an abode, hence it is also applied to the womb: see गर्भाशय.

n. (-नं)
A ceremony performed prior to conception.
E.
गर्भ the embryo, and आधान taking, being supposed conducive to future impregnation.

m. (-मः)
The eighth month of uterine gestation.
2 The eighth year reckoning from conception.
E.
गर्भ the foetus, and अष्टम eighth.

f. (-णी)
1 A pregnant woman.
2 A plant, (Asclepias rosea.)
E.
गर्भ embryo, and इनि poss. affix, fem. affix ङीप्.

n. (-णं)
Midwifery, attendance and care of pregnant women and new born infants.
E.
गर्भिणी, and अवेक्षण care, looking to.

f. (-नी)
A cow (or female), miscarrying from going unseasonably.
E.
गर्भ the foetus, उप intensitive prefix, हन to destroy, affixes णिनि and ङीप्.

f. (-का)
A species of rice.

f. (-म्मुत्)
1 A kind of grass.
2 Gold.
3 A reed.
E.
गॄ to swallow, &c. Uṇādi affix उति, and म inserted.

r. 1st cl. (गर्व्वति)
To be proud or haughty;
also (ङ) गर्व्वङ् r. 10th cl. (गर्व्वयते)
To grow proud.

m. (-र्व्वः)
Pride, arrogance.
E.
गर्व्व to be proud, affix अच् or गॄ swallow, &c. and व Uṇādi affix; this word is sometimes written गर्ब्ब.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Proud, haughty, arrogant.
E.
गॄ to reject, &c. Uṇādi affix स्वरच्.

m. (-टः)
A watchman, a doorkeeper, a sort of village constable, a headborough or beadle.
E.
गर्व्व pride, अट to go, and अच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Proud, haughty.
2 Conceited.
E.
गर्व्व pride, and इतच् aff.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (गर्हति-ते गर्हयति)
To blame, to censure, to despise or contemn.

f. (-र्हा)
Abuse, censure, reproach.
E.
गर्ह to revile, affixes अङ् and टाप्.

n. (-णं)
Censuring, censure, blame, reproach.
E.
गर्ह to reprove, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Censurable, contemptible, vile, bad.
E.
गह to abuse, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Blamed, censured.
2 Contemned, despised.
3 Bad, vile.
E.
गर्ह to blame, क्त aff.

mfn. (-र्ह्यः-र्ह्या-र्ह्यं)
Low, vile, contemptible.
E.
गर्ह to abuse, affix यत्.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Speaking ill, speaking vilely or inaccurately.
E.
गर्ह्य vile, and वादिन् who speaks.

m. (-त्रः)
Rice, grain, corn.
E.
ग to swallow, Uṇādi affix णित्रन.

m. (-कः)
A charmer, a dealer in antidotes.
E.
गारुड the mantra of GARUḌA, or a charm against venom, and ठक् aff.

f. (-डी)
Hog-weed, (Boerhavia diffusa alata.)

n. (-कं)
A multitude of the descendants of the saint GARGA.
E.
गार्ग a descendant of GARGA, and वुञ् affix of multitude; also with ठञ्, गार्गिक.

m. (-निः)
A descendant of the son of GĀRGĪ.
E.
गार्गी the wife of the saint GARGA, पुत्र a son, and फिञ् affix, कुक् augment; also without the augment गार्ग्गीपुत्रायनि, or with इञ् affix, गार्ग्गीपुत्रि.

mfn. (-र्ग्ग्यः-र्ग्ग्यी-र्ग्ग्यं)
Descended from GARGA, son, daughter, &c.
E.
गर्ग्ग, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-क्षः)
An arrow.
E.
गार्द्ध, and पक्ष a wing; formed with vulture's feathers.

m. (-क्षः)
An arrow.
E.
गार्द्ध, and पक्ष a wing.

m. (-त्रः)
An arrow.
E.
as before, पत्र a leaf, a wing.

n. (-र्द्ध्यं)
1 Greediness.
2 Desire.
E.
गृध greedy, यञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Foetal, uterine.
2 Relating to or connected with gestation or the foetus in utero.
E.
गभ, and ठञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
A number of pregnant women.
E.
गर्भिणी a pregnant woman, and अण् aff.

n. (-ण्यं)
An assembly of pregnant women.
E.
गर्भिणी as above, and यञ् aff.

m. (-त्यः)
A sacred fire perpetually maintained by a householder, received from his father, and transmitted to his descendants, and from which fires for sacrificial purposes are lighted.
E.
गृहपति a householder, (from गृह a house, and पति master,) and ज्य referential aff.

n. (-स्थ्यं)
The order or estate of a householder.
E.
गृहस्थ, and यञ् aff.
